boundaries.coverage: webLogin/nativeLogin pages only; capture spans attachment through ordinary context close and can include tail; budgets use only the unchanged two windows; no cold FIRST capture; initial Native document may precede attachment
boundaries.identity: per-document UUID and timeOrigin; CDP loader IDs are separate local identities, not a guessed cross-layer join
boundaries.delivery: asynchronous test binding; missing delivery, other schema values and overflow remain incomplete; failure/pending counters sum observations and can repeat at snapshot/seal
boundaries.clocks: product monotonicMs is relative to its actual document timeOrigin; wallMs and CDP monotonic clocks are separate
boundaries.cost: retained rows/bytes are bounded; per-event CPU/IPC delivery is not capped and occurs inside original windows; no production performance claim
boundaries.unknownAssociation: no user, workspace, raw SWR key, URL query, headers, body or server invocation ID; ambiguous action/time joins remain unknown
